text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. A balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains gives you energy and helps you stay well. Regular exercise, such as walking, swimming, or cycling, keeps your heart strong and reduces stress. Getting enough sleep is also important, because your body and brain need rest to work properly. Mental health matters just as much as physical health, so take time to relax and talk about your feelings. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. When you manage your time well, you can enjoy your job and your free time without feeling too tired.
